name: io.github.Servosity/rocketcyber-mcp
title: RocketCyber MCP
description: CLI and MCP server for RocketCyber Managed SOC: triage, MTTR, and posture analytics.

environmentVariables.name: ROCKETCYBER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Set the ROCKETCYBER_API_TOKEN credential for the RocketCyber MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: ROCKETCYBER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the RocketCyber API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: ROCKETCYBER_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

environmentVariables.name: ROCKETCYBER_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: ROCKETCYBER_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on RocketCyber requests.

environmentVariables.name: ROCKETCYBER_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.
